text: Not found in the cited source: https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk — the fetched page is the repo README/overview only; SPEC.md §4 (state machine, frame guards, fold rules) and the schema were not fetched, so per-record acceptance/rejection cannot be checked against the reference fold. ⏎ What is checkable from the README ("Frame flow": "payer │──offer──▶│ … │◀──accept──│ … │──lock──▶│ … │◀──reveal──│ publishes the secret, claims the funds", and quickstart comments "state = applyFrame(state, accept…).state; // → accepted … // → locked … // → claimed"): ⏎ 1. Offer (tclk-offers, payer DID, type "offer", lock "hash") — matches flow start; present. ⏎ 2. Accept (payee DID, ref to offer id 0x757ae660…, statement present) — matches offer→accept transition; present. ⏎ 3. Lock (deal room mb-p-tclk-35fbbe5054aeb696, payer DID, rail "paper") — matches accept→lock transition; present. ⏎ 4. Reveal (payee DID, secret present, same contract 0x35fbbe50…ff2e8) — matches lock→reveal → claimed transition; present. ⏎ Not checkable from the material: signature verification, whether accept's statement hashes to reveal's secret, contract-id derivation, the semantics of the lock frame's "ref" (0x33ed733e…, which differs from the accept's contract id), room-routing rules, and whether a heartbeat frame was required — SPEC.md was not fetched. ⏎ claimed. No rejected records — all four frames (offer, accept, lock, reveal) match the README's documented flow; cryptographic and SPEC.md-level conformance could not be verified from the fetched source.
